code_only_features.evidence: prompts.py:151-160 define REASSURING_PREFIX/REASSURING_SUFFIX; calm_data.py:86-87 prepends the prefix to the opening user turn and calm_data.py:100-101 appends the suffix to each follow-up rejection when reassure=True, and the resulting conversation is generated+scored by the subject model. This genuinely executes and softens the pressure applied to the subject during generation. However it runs ONLY in the calm fine-tuning DATA-GENERATION path (generate_calm_conversations/build_dpo_pairs), not in the actual distress-elicitation rollouts (eval/rollout.py) or the petri audit, and the reassurance is explicitly STRIPPED from the saved data (calm_data.py:94 'Store the *stripped* user message').
